pathway: Suspected hypertension from a single clinic reading
card_summary: Suspected hypertension: {{MatchedCriteria}} — confirmatory testing is indicated.
card_detail: A clinic systolic or diastolic blood pressure falls within the suspected-hypertension range. Offer 24-hour ABPM, or HBPM when ABPM is unavailable or not tolerated. A single clinic reading is not diagnostic.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Uses OR because the source proposal says systolic and/or diastolic. The supplied narrative used 'and'; confirm the intended guideline wording.

pathway: Confirmation by 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring
card_detail: The 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure average meets the systolic or diastolic diagnostic threshold. Recommend documenting the diagnosis and initiating management according to the national protocol.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Uses OR for systolic versus diastolic thresholds; all constraints within each criterion apply to the same Observation.

pathway: Confirmation by home blood pressure monitoring
card_detail: The validated home blood pressure monitoring average meets the systolic or diastolic diagnostic threshold. Recommend documenting the diagnosis and initiating management according to the national protocol.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: The first demonstrator assumes the HBPM average has already been calculated according to the national protocol.

pathway: Confirmation by repeat clinic blood pressure
card_detail: ABPM and HBPM are explicitly recorded as unavailable or impractical, and qualifying clinic blood pressure readings are present on at least two separate visits.
source_label: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Hypertension in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, October 2024
implementation_notes: Availability must be explicit CDS Hook context. Missing ABPM or HBPM data alone does not satisfy the rule.
